deck_port_context.text: # === Aligns the extracted netlist vs. the schematic ===
raise "Primitive conservation failed" unless nssoc_before == [1211120,1211120] && nssoc_after == nssoc_before
raise "Top port contract differs" unless nssoc_lp.size == 355 && nssoc_rp.size == 355 && nssoc_lp.map(&:upcase).sort == nssoc_rp.map(&:upcase).sort
max_branch_complexity(512) # diagnostic search bound, no acceptance change
logger.info('Starting SG13G2 LVS Comparison with flag_missing_ports')

top-inventory.json.scope: Saved netlist top pin names, direct device class counts and child type counts only. No detailed xref pair traversal, no graph changes, no acceptance.

xor-physical-path.json.scope: C/E-to-base backtrace includes feedback and shared bias branches; does not assume forward gain. Numeric wires collapsed only for reachability; measured physical-terminal waveforms retain all RC. Original phases/gates unchanged. No new simulation/layout/PHY acceptance.
